title: pikku-inspect --stdin output
description: What `pikku-inspect --stdin` writes to stdout when it exits 0: a finalized state, or `error` with the diagnostics logged before the failure. Mirrors InspectorGoOutput in src/protocol.ts. stderr is free-form and passed through to the user.

protocol.description: Protocol version. The wrapper rejects any other.

finalized.description: True: the binary always runs finalize. False only alongside `error`.

state.description: A SerializableInspectorState (packages/inspector/src/utils/serialize-inspector-state.ts), read with deserializeInspectorState. Absent when `error` is set.

diagnostics.description: Every message the TypeScript engine would have sent to its logger, in order. Replayed into the CLI logger.

files.description: Source files in the program, node_modules and lib included.

projectFiles.description: Files under rootDir the inspector swept.

error.description: Set when the inspection failed after it began logging (a schema that could not be generated, a fatal analysis error). The wrapper replays `diagnostics`, then throws this message.

validationPass.description: Present when the binary ran finalize's validation pass: the diagnostics logged between logger.beginValidationPass() and logger.endValidationPass(), as indices [start, end) into `diagnostics`. The wrapper replays the bracket around them.

code.description: An ErrorCode value, e.g. PKU123. A coded error or warn becomes a tracked diagnostic.
